items.title: Clarity Act Failure Triggers Industry Political Mobilization
points: Stand With Crypto (Coinbase-backed advocacy group) vowed to score every senator's vote on the Clarity Act for public voter reference ahead of midterm elections, framing it as a measure to hold elected officials accountable.
Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP ETFs experienced combined outflows of $593 million—their worst single-day loss since June—signaling market disappointment over the legislative setback.
Some analysts argued the act's failure may extend the current market bottom, but underlying pricing pressure stems primarily from U.S. dollar liquidity constraints rather than congressional action.

items.title: Circle's Arc Mainnet Launch and Institutional Blockchain Infrastructure
points: Circle launched Arc, a Layer 1 blockchain network (a base-layer blockchain that processes and finalizes its own transactions) with a permissioned (restricted-access) validator set including BlackRock, DTCC (Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation—the infrastructure backbone of U.S. securities settlement), and Visa.
The company pre-minted 10 billion ARC tokens but has not committed to a public token launch, leaving the token's distribution and trading status uncertain.

items.title: UK Ramps Up Anti-Money-Laundering Enforcement
points: The UK allocated $676 million and 500 new officers to combat money laundering.
Crypto was named alongside fintech and AI as a key driver of the estimated £100 billion annual money-laundering threat.

items.title: CoinEx Shuts Down After Nine Years
points: Crypto exchange CoinEx announced it is shutting down after nine years in operation.
